verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of Asana search across tasks, docs, and comments, and nothing on search speed or accuracy. The MCP prompt "Find all my incomplete tasks due this week" is only an example query. Gemini Enterprise cross-app search is a third-party integration, and the MCP read tools are a building block, not a search feature.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can search across all tasks, docs, and comments and get fast, accurate results
